title: Majestic Plan!
reviewNotes: All thirty-three diagrams and native ...f3 root/capture reviewed. Native image27 corrects the older review transcription: the source captures Rc2 with the b3 pawn, bxc2+, leaving Bb1 in place. Kc1 blocks the pawn and only f2 remains. Independent Bxc2+ is also legal; after Kc1 all seven bishop moves and f2 allow Bxb2 mate. Finite proof checks all three initial defenses, preserving all nine root pieces. Earlier larger king walk remains outside scope.
transcript: White's brilliant idea is rook to G1 check, and since this rook is pinned to the king, black is forced to play bishop to B1. And now white follows up with a mysterious move, rook to C1. What is the idea here? It seems like black is just winning. Both players have a bishop and a rook, but black has four extra pawns that it can try to push for a win. And since there is a pin on the bishop, a pin on the rook, and all three of these pawns are stuck, black only has one option, to push the C pawn. But it's not clear how white can make any progress. Taking this rook would be a massive mistake. After king takes, this black pawn is going to promote, and there is going to be no way to stop it. But white calmly plays king to G1 and starts to bring the king around into the black position. After the pawn reaches C3, white takes it, and now relinquishes the control on the other pawn, which starts to advance. This gives white just enough time to keep bringing the king. But once the king reaches D1, we realize that it is not clear what the idea of white is. The king cannot get any closer because of the bishop, and taking the rook would still not be good enough. But here we see the brilliant plan of white unfolding after the majestic rook to C2. A rook sacrifice that has to be accepted because if you push the pawn, this is just going to be a checkmate. But if black does take the rook, after king to C1, the checkmate threat is renewed. All of these pieces are completely stuck, so black has to push the pawn. And with only one step left before getting the queen, bishop to B2 will be a checkmate.
